description:
Crompton LIFE ESSENTIAL 500W mixer grinder with 3 jars is a daily-use kitchen workhorse for Indian cooking—wet grinding, dry masala, and quick chutneys without slowing you down. The 500‑watt motor delivers steady power for everyday ingredients like soaked dal, coconut, onions, tomatoes, and spice mixes, helping you get smoother pastes and more even powders. Use the 3‑speed control with pulse to crush, grind, and blend with better control, whether you’re making idli/dosa batter prep, gravy base, or coriander-mint chutney.

This Nigella edition comes in a clean purple-white finish and includes a liquidizing jar, dry grinding jar, and chutney jar—so you can switch tasks fast and keep the kitchen moving. Built-in overload protection helps protect the motor during tough batches, and anti-skid feet keep it stable on the counter. The standout promise is peace of mind: a 5‑year warranty on the motor (plus 2 years on the product) for long-term reliability in a busy home kitchen.
